verdict.rationale: OneDrive's own docs say file version history retention can be configured, including whether a new version is created per edit, per save, manually, or never. That is a thin slice of retention control, and the pack contains no evidence of user-facing deletion controls, retention policies, or data purge. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or durations, user-controlled deletion and purge (including recycle bin behavior), programmatic deletion APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: OneDrive and SharePoint can be configured to retain the history for files. Depending on the service and configuration, a new version can be created for each edit, each time the file is saved, manually, or never.
